note: P is one pan-seared, butter-basted, juniper-and-thyme bison/ribeye steak four times, with small differences (P2 adds a wine pan sauce, P3 a marinade and a real-mammoth framing, P4 a reverse sear and elk or venison). Q is nearly identical in all four: bone-in bison tomahawk, reverse-seared, carved at the table, with the same permafrost and 50 CFR opening and the same thaw and dry-brine structure.
